member.name: T:ReadyM.Utils.Async.PumpAwaiter
member.summary: Awaiter for . Always suspends exactly once and resumes the continuation on the next pump, directly on the pump thread. Resumption is scheduled straight onto the context (not via the ambient ), so a method that only awaits is pump-thread-bound regardless of any SynchronizationContext-capture subtlety.

member.name: T:ReadyM.Utils.Async.PumpedSynchronizationContext
member.summary:
A single-threaded whose queued continuations run only when the owner calls , on the pumping thread. This lets async/await code run entirely on a caller-owned thread that is advanced cooperatively, instead of on the thread pool. It is thread-agnostic: the "pump thread" is simply whichever thread calls (a game loop, a worker, a test), and an application may create several independent contexts for different purposes.
Grounded in well-documented references (single-threaded SynchronizationContexts are famously easy to get wrong): - Stephen Toub, "Await, SynchronizationContext, and Console Apps" (the canonical single-threaded pump). - Microsoft.VisualStudio.Threading's SingleThreadedSynchronizationContext. - The System.Threading.SynchronizationContext docs. Unlike Toub's blocking RunOnCurrentThread loop, is NON-blocking: it drains the work queued so far and returns, so the host stays in control of its loop.

member.name: M:ReadyM.Utils.Async.PumpedSynchronizationContext.Start(System.Action)
member.summary: Runs on the calling (pump) thread with this context installed as . Use it to START an async method so its pre-await body and its captured continuations bind to this context. Must be called from the thread that will pump.

member.name: M:ReadyM.Utils.Async.PumpedSynchronizationContext.Pump
member.summary: Drains the continuations queued AS OF entry, on the calling thread, with this context installed as Current (so nested awaits re-capture it). Work queued DURING the pump waits for the next pump, so a continuation that re-queues itself cannot starve the caller within a single tick. A continuation that throws is logged and dropped (the pump keeps draining and stays alive); it is never swallowed silently. Returns the number of continuations executed.

member.summary: Suspends the awaiting async method until the next , resuming ON THE PUMP THREAD. If is cancelled, resumption throws (still on the pump thread, so the method's finally/using run there).
